notes.title: FAITH v1.666
notes.content:
[i][h3]FAITHFUL!

We bring to you today v1.666!

As [u][i]FAITH: The Unholy Trinity[/i][/u] officially launches in Japan![/h3][/i]
[previewyoutube=0gr81EkXC7s;full][/previewyoutube]
Full Japanese localization (including VO) is now available on [b]PC and Nintendo Switch[/b]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1179080/FAITH_The_Unholy_Trinity/
Thanks to our friends at [url=https://faith.happinet-games.com/]Happinet![/url]

[list]
[*] https://www.amazon.co.jp/s?hidden-keywords=B0F2RWC936%7CB0F2S6WTSQ&_encoding=UTF8
[*] https://geo-online.co.jp/store_info/item/5156010/
[*] https://store-jp.nintendo.com/item/software/D70010000093135
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36099340/4b953400f526af281bc000ee52e6f1a286dace4f.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36099340/e25fdb8c7dba9c5c120ab9399620a7017e5f15ad.png[/img]

Plus the John Ward Youtooz figure is up for [url=https://youtooz.com/products/john-ward]pre order NOW![/url] 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36099340/95a2dbdff9542878ca83ace972ed72dd42410d8d.png[/img]
[i]Finally you can bring Father John Ward home with you and keep yourself safe from Demons 🙏[/i]

[b]Amen.[/b]

[b]Full Patch Notes:[/b]

[b]SUMMARY:[/b]

[list]
[*] Added Japanese language localization and options to change text and/or voices to English or Japanese from the Main Menu
[*] Cutscene skipping is now done by holding B button/Enter key
[*] Fixes to issues related to skipping cutscenes
[*] Fixes to loading audiogroups
[*] Reduced radius of boss Amy’s circle of symbols attack during phase 3 of the fight
[*] Fixed softlocks in Chapters 2 and 3
[*] Various fixes for v1.5 issues
[/list]
[b]DETAILED PATCH NOTES:
[/b]
[b]GENERAL[/b]

[list]
[*] Added Japanese language localization (text and voices). Language options can be changed in the Main Menu
[*] Game audiogroups have been significantly optimized to improve loading times and lower overall file size
[*] Cutscene skipping is now done by holding down B button or ENTER key
[*] Modified certain title/intro sequences so that they can only be skipped by holding down B button or ENTER key
[*] Fixed issues related to skipping cutscenes (game event flags weren’t changing after skipping)
[*] Addressed bugs where skipping certain cutscenes would activate the “auto cross” glitch
[*] Fixed bugs where loading a save would activate the “auto cross” glitch
[*] Optimized texture pages for all 3 chapters
[*] Turbo is deactivated in pause menus
[*] Added Interndorfs to game credits
[*] Changed “back” button on PS5 controller to Circle
[*] Pressing down on the PS5 controller touch pad or PS button no longer acts like d-pad input
[*] If no controller is connected, player will not be able to adjust controller rumble option
[*] Added input cooldown when switching between fullscreen/windowed modes
[*] Minor adjustments to text alignment and spacing when displayed in text boxes
[*] Fixed Catechismus Mode demon’s sprite draw depth
[*] Restored glitch effect for FAITH titles during intro if chromatic aberration effect is enabled
[/list]
[b]CHAPTER I[/b]

[list]
[*] Fixed bug where “heartbeat” controller rumble effect made the controller rumble non-stop if player changed screens
[*] Reduced the radius of Boss Amy’s satanic symbols attack during phase 3 of her boss fight
[*] (Flashlight/Lantern Modes) Flashlight/lantern modes activate once John gets out of his car
[/list]

[b]CHAPTER II[/b]

[list]
[*] Fixed code handling saving/loading that was preventing audiogroups from loading properly
[*] Fixed draw depth issues with Thrall enemies
[*] Audiogroup for Garcia’s apartment now loads in properly upon starting a new game
[*] Fixed behavior where Spindly Lady was spawning right on top of John before rushing him
[*] Fixed bugs related to the demon hand not being able to grab the child in front of the confession booth in the church
[*] Fixed softlock in church basement where John would get stuck if going back into the clock symbols puzzle from the “Mother of Demons” room
[*] Adjusted position of Blind One enemy to not be right on top of John when he re-enters Blind Ones room after getting the key in Sanctum
[*] Fixed softlock in Sanctum where player could get stuck re-entering the Blind Ones room after getting the key
[*] Fixed audio glitch during first Miriam cutscene in Sanctum
[*] Fixed bug related to extra pause menu handler obj spawning at the start of Miriam boss fight
[*] Torches in Miriam’s boss fight arena will properly turn off during phase 2 of the battle and turn back on in phase 3
[*] Adjusted audio gain during Miriam boss “defeated” cutscene
[*] Fixed bug where skipping ending cutscenes wouldn’t stop John’s monologuing
[*] (Prologue) fixed rare null ref if John collides with the first cornfield thrall while engulfed in flames
[/list]

[b]CHAPTER III[/b]

[list]
[*] John’s cross is now the proper color during certain flashback sequences
DAY 1
[*] Skipping the intro cutscene of John and Allred in the car now properly stops any voice line playback
[*] Player can no longer get stuck inside John’s gurney when getting saved by rent-a-cop or returning to the Clinic basement
[*] “Get back on?” trigger for John’s gurney now much easier to activate
[*] Bug where players would get stuck between the two Clinic basement rooms and/or between the Mommy boss room and the hallway before it is, now and forever, assuredly, eternally, and irrevocably fixed (real) (not fake)
 DAY 2
[*] Player can now press B button or Escape key to exit elevator “Which floor?” prompt
[*] Elevator Friend’s breathing/aggro/fleeing cries will interrupt each other instead of overlapping
[*] Controller rumble stops when screen goes black during the “Alu possession” cutscene
[*] Pressing a floor button that you're already on does not reset the Elevator Game sequence, only new floors that are out-of-sequence
[*] Elevator Woman spawning now resets if player resets the Elevator Game
[*] Changed chance of Elevator Woman spawning to 50% (see her lore on the web)
[*] Game no longer spams you with loud “carswerve” sfx when Elevator Woman attacks player
[*] Fixed bug where Tiffany would fly far off-screen during her DVD logo bouncing attack and take forever to get back
[*] Fixed bugs related to the background music tracks playing/not playing when they’re supposed to after loading saves and/or defeating Tiffany
DAY 3
[*] Removed stole from Father Allred’s sprite in Flashback 4
[*] Daycare music will restart if player exits Garyland before getting locked in
[*] Exiting Garyland before getting locked in will no longer reset the moon/chalice/bird/star puzzle
[*] Big Demon Head can no longer warp John to the Asylum area if John collides with it while it’s in its “dying” state
[*] Moloch chains sfx playback now stops properly when exiting Moloch room
[*] Lantern no longer respawns if John collects it, leaves the room, and returns to the room it originally spawns in
[*] Fixed softlock related to skipping the “seal breaking” cutscene while progressing through Nowhere Forest
[*] Removed code resetting cross “active” state during Astaroth boss fight
[*] Changed pathetic groveling simp Gary’s sprite draw depth during “Amy…Amy mea…” cutscene to look better
[*] Ending 3 audiogroup now loads properly when starting that sequence
[*] Opening the locked door in John’s house no longer takes the key out of the inventory
[*] Fixed visual bug where “fade from black” effect wasn’t displaying properly in cutscene of John kneeling before Amy
[/list]
[b]SURVIVAL:[/b]

[list]
[*] “Fight it, John” prompt now works as intended in Lisa/Alu room
[*] Fixed stray black pixels that appear on top of John when he exits the second Peekaboo room
[*] Fixed draw depth of chain link fence at top of the screen just before Tiffany’s room
[/list]
[b]NO DEMONS WORLD:[/b]

[list]
[*] Fixed mis-matched audio and text for some of John’s dialogue lines
[/list]
[b]KNOWN ISSUES:[/b]

[list]
[*] Possible compatibility issues with some directInput controllers
[*] Possible control issues when Steam Input is enabled
[*] Possible issue with bluetooth 8BitDo controllers while playing on Steam Deck (updating controller firmware appears to have fixed issue)
[*] Background music track issues may persist when loading saves during the latter part of the Apartments area
[*] Rare instances where game manually disables cross “active” state (mostly during certain boss fights) - if you’re a speedrunner you likely already know where these instances are
[*] John is still able to collect the Chapter II cemetery key, summon and defeat Pentarox, re-enter the Save Family tomb, collect the key again, and re-summon Pentarox indefinitely (does not appear to cause game-breaking issues also it’s funny)
[/list]

[b]SUGOIIIIIIIIIIIIIIIIIIIII[/b]

notes.title: FAITH v1.5
notes.content:
[h2]BEHOLD! Faith v1.5 is here \o/[/h2]

[h3]Bringing with it a whole bunch of updates like...[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36099340/86724e97a8ef6c0035be82e61f6d312d0925415e.jpg[/img]
[b]Skippable Cutscenes:[/b] Players can now hold down the space bar or the action button on their gamepad to skip virtually all rotoscoped cutscenes and most in-game conversations, making it easier to get back into boss fights, attempt speedruns, re-attempt Good Christian Boy achievement, etc.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36099340/87477ecd1332b38a128a1cf0140e1e60c6bc3971.png[/img]

[b]More Consistent Demon Combat:[/b] Previously the game would manually turn off John’s cross at certain points during certain boss battles, requiring the player to un-press the space bar/action button and use the cross again. This was mostly during transitions between bosses’ various phases and was meant to encourage adaptive, strategic play. However it’s clear that players were just left confused why their cross stopped randomly working while holding the cross up, leading to frustration. This should make boss battles like Amy and Miriam (especially when it comes to keeping Father Garcia alive) a little easier

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36099340/699473ef5e6813fb4ad66682717d54f11f31d84e.jpg[/img]
[b]Audio and Texture Optimization:[/b] Duplicate/unnecessary audio files and texture images were removed. Some very large sprite images were downsized to fit better in texture pages. Players should get faster loading times for “hymns” during the bootup sequence and less delay when the game loads certain texture pages

[b]Skippable Long Notes:[/b] Players can press space bar/action button to skip to the bottom of long notes if they don’t feel like scrolling through them

[b]Go Back With Esc/B Button:[/b] Player can now press B on the gamepad (or esc on the keyboard) to instantly go back a screen when navigating menus

[b]STRETCH-O-RAMA Now Fits Retro Monitors:[/b] Fullscreen Stretch-o-rama now properly “fills” your display, whether it’s 4:3, 5:4 or ultrawide 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36099340/bc1cac22128855c9102c0a295a101dbd9752a17b.jpg[/img]
[b]DirectInput Gamepad Functionality:[/b] Added limited functionality for PlayStation DualSense and other dinput-style gamepads. Please note that rumble probably won’t work with these gamepads (it’s a GameMaker issue) and some buttons that the game doesn’t use might have unpredictable in-game effects

[b]Flashlight Visibility Adjustment:[/b] John’s sprite is now a little easier to see when using the flashlight!

[b]New animated cutscene:[/b] A brief animated cutscene has been added to one of the flashback sequences

And we've done all this because [b]FAITH IS LAUNCHING ON NINTENDO SWITCH![/b]

[previewyoutube=BsowESe_-S4;full][/previewyoutube]
[h3]When? NEXT WEEK!

Plus you can still order the physical edition [url=https://www.fangamer.com/collections/new-and-featured/products/faith-the-unholy-trinity-physical-game-nintendo-switch]from Fangamer![/url][/h3]

[url=https://www.fangamer.com/collections/new-and-featured/products/faith-the-unholy-trinity-physical-game-nintendo-switch][img]https://i.imgur.com/9nzXNJl.png[/img][/url]

[h3]What's next for [i]FAITH? [/i]

Faith in Japan! Faith translated into other languages! FAITH on Xbox and Playstation?! FAITH IN YOUR HOME BECAUSE YOU SIN TOO MUCH!

GARY KNOWS WHAT YOU DO, [i]SINNER.[/i]

BUT GARY LOVES YOU <3[/h3]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1179080/FAITH_The_Unholy_Trinity/

[b]Full Changelog[/b]

[u]FAITH v1.5[/u]

TL:DR

[list]
[*] Nearly every animated cutscene and most in-game conversations are now skippable
[*] Boss battles no longer manually disable the cross at certain points
[*] Faster loading times for “hymns” and textures
[*] Player can now skip to the end of longer notes and go back in menus with a single button press
[*] Improved display compatibility on retro displays
[*] DirectInput gamepad functionality
[*] Improved appearance when using flashlight
[*] Improved accessibility when searching for Spindly Lady
[*] New animated cutscene
[*] Various crash and bug fixes and minor adjustments
[/list]
[u]Full Patch Notes[/u]

[b][u]Crash fixes[/u][/b]

Chapter 2:

[list]
[*] Fixed crash that sometimes happens after a thrall kills Garcia during phase 1 of the Miriam fight
[/list]
Chapter 3:

[list]
[*] Fixed crash to desktop that sometimes happens when reaching Chapter 3 in Marathon Mode
[*] Fixed crash to desktop if demon babies are left crawling around Mother after devouring her at the end of her boss fight
[*] Fixed rare freeze that happens if the game can’t find a good place to spawn John’s cross if he gets hit by Gary during his boss fight
[/list]
Survival:

[list]
[*] Various crash fixes due to all the demons interacting with each other in “Demoned” mode
[/list]
[u][b]Bug fixes[/b][/u]

Chapter 1:

[list]
[*] Fixed “nasus” text overlapping with dark gray informative text at the bottom of the pause menu
[/list]
Chapter 2:

[list]
[*] Fixed bug that causes the controller to rumble continuously during the secret ending cutscene of Chapter II Prologue
[*] Fixed bug that, in some cases, spawned an extra instance of the cross’ “holy” volume at the start of Chapter 2, resulting in the cross being twice as powerful as it should be throughout the Chapter
[*] Fixed bug that starts John out with the “auto-cross” glitch when loading their game at certain points of Chapter 2
[*] Fixed bug that made the Cemetery maze not resolve even after the player walked the correct path
[*] Fixed bug that didn’t properly save the “last room” global variable to the Chapter 2 save file
[*] Fixed bug in the Church that caused the controller to rumble continuously until the player pauses the game
[*] If Miriam morphs into a larger size in phase 1 of her boss fight, she will stay that way in phases 2 and 3
[*] Fixed coding error that checked for Chapter 1 ending 2 instead of Chapter 2 ending 2 when calculating the total number of Chapter 2 endings that the player has reached
[/list]
Chapter 3:

[list]
[*] Fixed bug where the game background changes to “Sutexii” when starting Chapter 3
[*] Fixed bug where John could walk behind the walls in Mother boss’ room
[*] Candles found throughout the apartment complex no longer appear lit when the player is supposed to be in total darkness (basement, camera sequence)
[*] Lisa no longer appears “damaged” while running away from the Alu boss fight room
[*] (Flashback 3) Fixed the color of John’s cross as it appears in the master bedroom mirror
[*] Entering the moon/chalice/bird/star puzzle room in the Daycare no longer resets the music if the music is currently playing
[*] Fixed draw depth bug when the chairs in the Garyland chair puzzle change position
[*] Fixed bug where Garyland audio files don’t load after the chair puzzle and completing Flashback 4
[*] Fixed Moloch room bug where the flame that appears in one hand after sacrificing a key will jump to the other hand if you exit and re-enter the room
[*] (Ending 2) Blood rain no longer appears in front of dialogue text boxes during certain cutscenes
[*] (Ending 3) Lightning flashes coming through through the windows of John’s house no longer stay permanently after quitting/dying and re-loading during the home invasion sequence
[/list]
Survival:

[list]
[*] John can no longer walk through the east and west walls in Amy’s (boss) room
[*] Fixed second Basement Demon fight where it was warping outside of the room boundaries during its “YOU CAN’T CATCH ME” phase
[*] Draw depth of giant gore pile outside of Tiffany’s fight now works properly
[*] Fixed bug where John could get stuck in a wall when moving from one Jeffrey room to the next
[*] Fixed visual and scripting bugs with the 3 “plagas” cultists when they are all running around trying to grab John with their tentacles
[*] Fixed bug where John’s “extra chances” during the Super Miriam fight would not reset to their full amount after dying and re-starting the fight
[*] Game now correctly keeps track of demons defeated (if any) during “Demoned” mode. Note that enemies that spawn indefinitely like Miriam’s thralls and the Malphas Acolytes will not count towards your demons defeated stat
[/list]
Misc:

[list]
[*] Added code properly shutting down Steam API functionality when the game ends
[*] Game now properly remembers the window size when switching from fullscreen to windowed
[*] Fixed certain backgrounds showing tiny white/green lines on the outer edges on some screens
[/list]

[u][b]Adjustments[/b][/u]

Chapter 1:

[list]
[*] If John dies to Amy during her first phase, they no longer have to hear their entire conversation again to restart the fight. Rather, they re-spawn at “SHE IS MINE, PRIEST”
[*] The GWOB (gun with one bullet) now correctly displays in the pause menu
[*] New save point added just before John grabs the gun and shoots the mirror a third and final time
[*] Added audio cues for the house front door and attic door opening
[/list]
Chapter 2:

[list]
[*] Church music now pauses during Spindly Lady fight
[*] If Rumble is enabled, the controller will now vibrate with each stab during Thrall stabbing cutscenes
[*] Pausing is now enabled during cutscene of John melting
[*] Added water drips to pipes in the Candy Tunnel
[*] Added heartbeat-style controller vibrations (if Rumble is enabled) when Peekaboo is close to John in the Candy Tunnel
[*] Toned down how much the gamepad vibrates during Miriam’s boss battle when she sneaks up behind you in her second phase
[/list]
Chapter 3:

[list]
[*] In the sequence where John is strapped to the gurney in the Clinic, it is now super obvious which curtain the player is supposed to hide behind
[*] The wait time to get the Clinic secret basement door to open has been reduced by half
[*] New save points added after John cleanses the ritual knife/ritual mask
[*] In the Lisa/Alu boss fight, Alu has slightly less influence over John if he possesses him and tries to get him to kill Lisa
[*] New audio cue plays if John successfully completes the steps needed to enter the Unseen World in the Apartments
[*] Bob Martin can now be repelled with the cross when he appears in the master bedroom mirror in a certain flashback
[*] Father Allred’s stole is added to the “opening the door” cutscene and it can now be found a short distance away from his body during a certain flashback sequence
[*] Adjusted speed of “Plagas” cultists from Garyland/outside the Crucible when they rush John’s position or try to get to either side of him to be a little slower
[*] (Ending 3) During the home invasion sequence, John must retrieve the item from the basement before he can leave out the front door
[/list]
Survival:

[list]
[*] “Are you sure” prompt now appears when starting a new Survival run
[*] Improvements to how ranks are calculated
[*] Big arcade-style flashing arrows now point John in the right direction after certain boss encounters
[/list]
Misc:

[list]
[*] The game window no longer constantly re-positions itself to the top-left corner of the screen during play
[*] Slowed down the rate at which the player can scroll through menus when holding down gamepad analog sticks 
[*] It is now much easier for the player to toggle Chapter I Flashlight/Lantern modes on/off
[*] The borders of “closer look” images like the Michael polaroids and Clinic ultrasounds are now solid, matching the borders of dialogue text
[*] Added controller rumble for each stab of the “Thrall attack” cutscene
[*] Enabling/disabling demons can now only be done from the main menu configs screen (not from the pause menu)
[*] Screen says “end of chapter” instead of “game over” at the conclusion of Chapters I and II
[*] If the player has controller rumble enabled, cleansing objects will rumble the controller a bit when the little ghost thingy pops up
[*] Text of John’s comment about “fresh cheeseburgers” now matches the audio
[*] Improved the “Invertis” screen effect to more accurately represent inverted colors
[*] Added a tiny disclaimer to the game credits
[/list]

(Flashback 3) Fixed the color of John’s cross as it appears in the master bedroom mirror
Entering the moon/chalice/bird/star puzzle room in the Daycare no longer resets the music if the music is currently playing
Fixed draw depth bug when the chairs in the Garyland chair puzzle change position
Fixed bug where Garyland audio files don’t load after the chair puzzle and completing Flashback 4
Fixed Moloch room bug where the flame that appears in one hand after sacrificing a key will jump to the other hand if you exit and re-enter the room
(Ending 2) Blood rain no longer appears in front of dialogue text boxes during certain cutscenes
(Ending 3) Lightning flashes coming through through the windows of John’s house no longer stay permanently after quitting/dying and re-loading during the home invasion sequence
John can no longer walk through the east and west walls in Amy’s (boss) room
Fixed second Basement Demon fight where it was warping outside of the room boundaries during its “YOU CAN’T CATCH ME” phase
Draw depth of giant gore pile outside of Tiffany’s fight now works properly
Fixed bug where John could get stuck in a wall when moving from one Jeffrey room to the next
Fixed visual and scripting bugs with the 3 “plagas” cultists when they are all running around trying to grab John with their tentacles
Fixed bug where John’s “extra chances” during the Super Miriam fight would not reset to their full amount after dying and re-starting the fight

Game now correctly keeps track of demons defeated (if any) during “Demoned” mode. Note that enemies that spawn indefinitely like Miriam’s thralls and the Malphas Acolytes will not count towards your demons defeated stat
Added code properly shutting down Steam API functionality when the game ends
Game now properly remembers the window size when switching from fullscreen to windowed
Fixed certain backgrounds showing tiny white/green lines on the outer edges on some screens

tags.balance_change: More Consistent Demon Combat: Previously the game would manually turn off John’s cross at certain points during certain boss battles, requiring the player to un-press the space bar/action button and use the cross again. This was mostly during transitions between bosses’ various phases and was meant to encourage adaptive, strategic play. However it’s clear that players were just left confused why their cross stopped randomly working while holding the cross up, leading to frustration. This should make boss battles like Amy and Miriam (especially when it comes to keeping Father Garcia alive) a little easier

Audio and Texture Optimization: Duplicate/unnecessary audio files and texture images were removed. Some very large sprite images were downsized to fit better in texture pages. Players should get faster loading times for “hymns” during the bootup sequence and less delay when the game loads certain texture pages
Flashlight Visibility Adjustment: John’s sprite is now a little easier to see when using the flashlight!
If John dies to Amy during her first phase, they no longer have to hear their entire conversation again to restart the fight. Rather, they re-spawn at “SHE IS MINE, PRIEST”
The GWOB (gun with one bullet) now correctly displays in the pause menu
New save point added just before John grabs the gun and shoots the mirror a third and final time
Added audio cues for the house front door and attic door opening
Church music now pauses during Spindly Lady fight
If Rumble is enabled, the controller will now vibrate with each stab during Thrall stabbing cutscenes
Pausing is now enabled during cutscene of John melting
Added water drips to pipes in the Candy Tunnel
Added heartbeat-style controller vibrations (if Rumble is enabled) when Peekaboo is close to John in the Candy Tunnel
Toned down how much the gamepad vibrates during Miriam’s boss battle when she sneaks up behind you in her second phase
In the sequence where John is strapped to the gurney in the Clinic, it is now super obvious which curtain the player is supposed to hide behind
The wait time to get the Clinic secret basement door to open has been reduced by half
New save points added after John cleanses the ritual knife/ritual mask
In the Lisa/Alu boss fight, Alu has slightly less influence over John if he possesses him and tries to get him to kill Lisa
New audio cue plays if John successfully completes the steps needed to enter the Unseen World in the Apartments
Bob Martin can now be repelled with the cross when he appears in the master bedroom mirror in a certain flashback
Father Allred’s stole is added to the “opening the door” cutscene and it can now be found a short distance away from his body during a certain flashback sequence
Adjusted speed of “Plagas” cultists from Garyland/outside the Crucible when they rush John’s position or try to get to either side of him to be a little slower
(Ending 3) During the home invasion sequence, John must retrieve the item from the basement before he can leave out the front door
“Are you sure” prompt now appears when starting a new Survival run
Improvements to how ranks are calculated
Big arcade-style flashing arrows now point John in the right direction after certain boss encounters
The game window no longer constantly re-positions itself to the top-left corner of the screen during play
Slowed down the rate at which the player can scroll through menus when holding down gamepad analog sticks
It is now much easier for the player to toggle Chapter I Flashlight/Lantern modes on/off
The borders of “closer look” images like the Michael polaroids and Clinic ultrasounds are now solid, matching the borders of dialogue text
Added controller rumble for each stab of the “Thrall attack” cutscene
Enabling/disabling demons can now only be done from the main menu configs screen (not from the pause menu)
Screen says “end of chapter” instead of “game over” at the conclusion of Chapters I and II
If the player has controller rumble enabled, cleansing objects will rumble the controller a bit when the little ghost thingy pops up
Text of John’s comment about “fresh cheeseburgers” now matches the audio
Improved the “Invertis” screen effect to more accurately represent inverted colors
Added a tiny disclaimer to the game credits

notes.title: v1.4 - The Good Christian Boy Update
notes.content:
[h3][b]HAPPY HALLOWEN, OH YE FAITHFUL[/b][/h3]

[h3][i]And what would Halloween be without a reason to dive back into FAITH with...[/i][/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36099340/bf9b6b1d57e67ee0ebf1be354693217284ba1752.jpg[/img]
FEATURING... [b]SURVIVAL MODE[/b], A SPECIAL[b] "NO DEMONS" MODE[/b] for people who have gotten the hardest achievement in the game and [b]MORE[/b]:

[previewyoutube=HRncwTEccWA;full][/previewyoutube]
- That's right, there's a special play mode with new art and music that is available for players who have earned the '[b]GOOD CHRISTIAN BOY[/b]' achievement and you can now also disable demons from the Options menu. Finally a video game achievement that's as rewarding as going to church!

- [b]SURVIVAL MODE[/b] is available after finding the good endings in Chapters I/II/III and finishing the Chapter 2 Prologue. Fight your way through a brand new environment encountering [i]every[/i] demon we can throw at you. Finishing a Survival run earns you one of ten ranks!

- We've added [b]FOUR new animated cutscenes[/b]. Wowza.

- There's a [b]new unlockable background[/b] by @DragonRoIlZ

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36099340/75c6d9b89e600b626981b2e3695e66ea302d9d5c.png[/img]

- The new [b]Survival Mode music track “Airdorf Medley” by Gavin Craum added to Soundtrack[/b]

- There's [b]TWO new Steam achievements[/b] related to Survival mode

- And a[b] new image added to production notebook archive[/b] in goodies. Neat.

[b][Fixes][/b]
[list]
[*] Game window remembers the window size % when enabling/disabling full screen
[*] Numerous fixes for issues related to cultists that transform into hideous tentacle creatures, particularly in rooms with multiple instances of these enemies
[*] Fixed moments where controller rumble won’t stop rumbling (rumbling can always be canceled by pausing)
[*] Pausing the game while in Turbo mode returns the game to normal speed to make menu navigation easier
[/list]
[b][Gameplay Adjustments][/b]
[list]
[*] Quitting the game now takes you to the Airdorf Games splash screen instead of putting you through the “bootup”/”LOADING HYMNS” screen again
[*] Reduced Alu boss’ hp by 25%
[*] Slightly reduced hp and movement speed of the secret DUSK enemy in Garyland
[*] (Survival only) Gary’s RAIN OF SPIDERS attack has a ⅛ chance of reading “AUSTRALIA”
[*] NOTE ABOUT FAITH: DEMON SIEGE - This is a fan game made by CrackedGhostGames. Any issues/questions/complaints about the game should be directed to the developer!
[/list]
[h3][i]Thanks for playing and remember...[/i][/h3]

[h3][b]GARY STILL LOVES YOU <3[/b][/h3]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1179080/FAITH_The_Unholy_Trinity/

notes.title: V1.3 - Happy Mother's Day
notes.content:
[i][h2]PRIEST, DON'T YOU WANT TO MEET THEM?[/h2][/i]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36099340/fb456c06967854857e074d867aa48f1885daca7f.png[/img]

[h3]This update has been in the works for quite some time, we hope you enjoy...[/h3]

[h3][b]General[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*]Replaced code that executes only while certain audio assets are playing with code dependent on a runtime timer. This may help players with under-performing computers to avoid softlocks, bugs, etc. resulting from audio files not being loaded and played on cue.
[*]Implemented controller rumble across all three Chapters. [b]Added new moments where the controller may rumble[/b]
[*]Achievements and unlockables can now be activated without Steam overlay needing to be enabled
[*]Draw order of text boxes versus "closer look" boxes has been fixed
[*]Fixed bugs where John could move around behind cutscenes as they play, potentially resulting in John wandering off-screen or warping to a screen he isn't supposed to
[*]Fixed bug where rapidly switching between values for "WINDOW SIZE" in configs causes window resizing to not work properly
[*]Cleaned up audio assets that were pre-loaded to and streaming from the game directory
[/list]
    [img]https://i.imgur.com/qgyW97g.gif[/img]

[h3][b]Chapter I[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*]Re-instated Michael jumpscare when attempting to pause the game when he is onscreen and aggro'd
[*]Michael "kill screen" cinematic now plays if Michael kills John at the end of the chapter
[*]Fixed bug where John could shoot the mirror from the side and never get gotten by the mirror demon
[/list][h3][b]Chapter II[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*]Fixed Garcia's animations during phase 3 of the final boss fight
[*]Fixed crash that sometimes happens when moving Garcia back up the basement stairs in the intro sequence
[*]Fixed crashes resulting from thralls getting confused about their intended target after killing Garcia during the Miriam boss battle
[*]Fixed crash resulting from waiting in the darkness and not doing anything after Garcia attempts to exorcise Michael in the intro sequence
[*]The mist clouds in the cemetery now disappear for good after beating the Mist Demon
[/list][h3][b]Chapter III[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*][b]Added a new spooky animated cutscene[/b]
[*]Fixed some existing cutscenes that used the wrong colors, had small graphical errors, etc.
[*]Fixed bug where the torches during the final boss fight may not serve their intended function
[*]Fixed bug where the camera flash wasn't working properly on slower computers (note: if your computer falls below the minimum specifications you may still run into this issue)
[*]Fixed crash after colliding with certain objects while strapped to the gurney
[*]Fixed crash resulting from leaving the room with Timmy's corpse without collecting his note
[*]Fixed crash after the outro cinematic showing the elevator after the apartments
[*]Fixed typo during flashback sequences
[*]Fixed bug where John can trigger the secret boss area cutscene by going one screen north instead of going to the door 
[/list]
[h3]Oh also these new Michael shirts [url=https://twitter.com/pitchcanker]designed by Pitch Canker[/url] are available:[/h3]

NewBloodStore.com NewBloodStore.com NewBloodStore.com NewBloodStore.com NewBloodStore.com
[url=https://newbloodstore.com/products/faith-michael-tee][img]https://i.imgur.com/Rindllx.png[/img][/url]
[b]Godspeed.[/b]

notes.title: A Profane Thanks
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36099340/4f9419e0e4db92a3bd283304fca456c5cf7dda88.png[/img]

Fellow believers: [b]Thank you[/b] to all the FAITHful for checking out [i]FAITH: The Unholy Trinity![/i] 

The response over this first week post-launch has been [b]incredible.[/b]

We're hard at work on some new additions (Twitch integration) and tweaks (more saves, cutscene skips) to the game, but for now we just wanted to give our humble thanks.

We've also updated the game with some changes!

[h2]FAITH v1.1[/h2]

[h3]General:[/h3]

[list]
[*] Fixed typos and naming inconsistencies in credits and notes
[*] Changed main menu music to avoid bogus copyright claims on YouTube
[/list]
[h3]Chapter I:[/h3]

[list]
[*] Fix for John getting stuck after "She is here" cinematic
[*] Adjusted rifle hitbox so it can be more easily picked up
[*] Fix for looping audio in basement
[/list]
[h3]Chapter II:[/h3]

[list]
[*] Fixes for crashes during Miriam boss battle
[*] Fix for crash when dying while lighting scarecrow on fire
[*] Fixes for being able to go out-of-bounds in narrow passageways in Candy Tunnel
[/list]
[h3]Chapter III:[/h3]

[list]
[*] Extra save in the "Nowhere" forest (full of Malphas acolytes)
[*] Fix for crash when dying while "Give up cross" prompt is displayed
[*] Fix for lantern/darkness effect staying visible when Malphas spawns into final boss battle
[*] Fix for Mirror Room Moloch Key being unobtainable after defeating Mirror demon and leaving the room
[*] Fix for bug where Jeffery aggros toward John immediately after spawning into Gurney sequence
[*] Fix for getting stuck in Lisa's room when returning after defeating Alu
[*] Fix for John going out-of-bounds during cinematic of Malphas seals breaking
[*] Fix for Gary getting stuck in his trident throwing animation during his battle
[*] Fix for invisible flames lighting John on fire during Astaroth/Malphas battle
[*] Fix for certain items being drawn on top of other items in pause menu
[*] Fixed note 42 not displaying in note reading mode in pause menu
[/list]
